抢匪和警方已经谈好了，但是惊变就在一瞬间，人质中，一个瘦弱的男人突然扑向最近的一个抢匪，抢匪一时不防，男人一口咬在抢匪的脖子上。

“啊！”抢匪惨叫一声。

娱乐文变丧尸文？

还能这么玩儿？

显然是时笙想多了，抢匪一把将男人推开，狠狠的踹了他一脚，男人摔在墙上，痛苦的呻吟了一声。

下一瞬又从地上跳起来，朝着抢匪扑过去，疯狂的大喊，“像你们这种败类就应该去死，去死，我要代表正义消灭你们，我是英雄！我是英雄！”

“妈的疯子，快把他拉开。”被攻击的那个抢匪暴怒的冲着旁边的人喊。

男人却像是打了鸡血，手脚并用，抓头发，嘴咬，只要是有效攻击，男人都会利用。

而趁着一个抢匪上前帮忙的时候，旁边出现了空缺，胆子大的人猛的从那边冲过去，往门口跑。

“砰！”

枪声猛的响起，疯狂的男人像是被按了暂停键，眼睛瞪圆，身子朝后倒去，鲜血从他身下流淌出来。

空间有一瞬间的凝滞。

“谁他妈让你开枪的！”站在另一头的一个抢匪怒吼了一声。

“啊！杀人了，救命啊啊！！”

“我不要死，我上有老下有小，放过我，放过我……”

“让我出去，让我出去！”

本是蹲着的人忽然都站了起来，争先恐后的往外面跑，抢匪估计也没真的想杀人，他们只是强悍用武力的将人堵回去。

那些人不知是不是猜到这一点，胆子忽然就大了起来，甚至有人开始抢枪。

混乱中，有人朝着时笙这边过来，他们面前的窗户可以直接出去，比走门快得多。

前后时间不过几秒，夏满反应过来，第一时间往窗户跑，也不知道是不是刚才太紧张，她一动，双脚竟然发软，踉跄着朝着前面扑去。

“砰！”又是一声枪响。

因为时笙一直拉着陆清韵的胳膊，在那个抢匪开枪的时候，时笙就扯着陆清韵朝着旁边闪去，顺手推了夏满一把，子弹擦着夏满的肩膀过去，射入地面。

“出去。”时笙指了指窗户。

即便是在这么混乱的情况下，陆清韵脸上的笑容依旧那么灿烂，看得人头皮发麻，冷汗直冒。

时笙赶紧移开视线，拽着他往窗户跑，两人一前一后的翻过窗户，迎面而来就是听到枪声，冲上来的警察，两人被迅速护到了后方。

The robbers and the police had already reached an agreement, but something unexpected happened in an instant. Among the hostages, a thin man suddenly pounced on the nearest robber. The robber was caught off guard and the man bit the robber on the neck.

"Ah!" the robber screamed.

Entertainment literature turns into zombie literature?

Can you still play like this?

Apparently Shi Sheng was overthinking it. The robber pushed the man away and kicked him hard. The man fell against the wall and groaned in pain.

The next moment, he jumped up from the ground, rushed towards the robbers, and shouted crazily, "Scum like you should die, die, I will destroy you on behalf of justice, I am a hero! I am a hero!"

"Damn madman, pull him away quickly." The robber who was attacked angrily shouted at the people next to him.

But the man seemed to have taken a shot, using his hands and feet, grabbing his hair, and biting his mouth. As long as it was an effective attack, the man would use it.

And when a robber came forward to help, a vacancy appeared next to him, and the brave people rushed over there and ran towards the door.

"Bang!"

The gunfire rang out violently, and the crazy man seemed to have been pressed on the pause button. His eyes widened and he fell backward, with blood flowing out from under him.

The space was stagnant for a moment.

"Who the hell asked you to shoot!" a robber standing on the other end roared.

"Ah! Someone killed someone, help me!!"

"I don't want to die. I have seniors and juniors above me. Let me go, let me go..."

"Let me out, let me out!"

The people who were squatting suddenly stood up and rushed outside. The robbers probably didn't really want to kill anyone. They just used force to block the people back.

Those people didn't know if they had guessed this, but they suddenly became bolder, and some even started to grab guns.

In the chaos, someone came towards Shi Sheng. They could go out directly through the window in front of them, which was much faster than walking through the door.

It only took a few seconds before Xia Man reacted and ran towards the window immediately. She didn't know if she was too nervous just now. When she moved, her feet became weak and she staggered forward.

"Bang!" There was another gunshot.

Because Shi Sheng kept pulling Lu Qingyun's arm, when the robber opened fire, Shi Sheng pulled Lu Qingyun away and pushed Xia Man aside. The bullet grazed Xia Man's shoulder and hit the ground.

"Get out." Shi Sheng pointed to the window.

Even in such a chaotic situation, the smile on Lu Qingyun's face was still so bright that it made people's scalp numb and cold sweat broke out.

Shi Sheng quickly looked away and dragged him towards the window. The two of them climbed over the window one after another. They were met by the police who rushed up after hearing the gunshots. The two of them were quickly escorted to the back.
